thread:
Evelyn Park: Quick questionor onboarding ops
bout a contractor->FT conversion. Samir Patel is set to convert Mon but hes currently in Denver finishing visa stamping. He needs to provide ORIGINAL I-9 docs. Hes asking if we can do a notary + courier pickup from his lawyer. Any compliance/legal blockers?
Devon Lee: For conversions we re-run background + benefits stuff. Background recheck flagged a tiny employer-name mismatch (ByteWave vs ByteWave Inc.). Usually a paystub or offer letter clears it.
Evelyn Park: I can upload an offer letter and a recent paystub. Main question is the I-9 originals pickup.
Legal Bot: Policy snippet: remote notarization acceptable on approved e-notary providers OR physical notarization with chain-of-custody courier. Create CASE-ONB-2026-912 when requesting courier.
Compliance: Need chain-of-custody form signed, courier audit log, and the notary certificate. Courier cost > $75 requires manager approval and finance code.
Marcus Holt: Facilities can accept courier deliveries M-F 09:00-16:00 at SF reception. We will sign and hand documents to HR only. We can timestamp receipt and store in secure locker.
Evelyn Park: Onboard Bot  can you kick off the notary+courier workflow and estimate cost? Samir prefers his lawyer to hand docs over directly.
Onboard Bot: CASE-ONB-2026-912 created. Recommended vendor: NotarifyPro (approved). Estimated courier + notary: $120. Chain-of-custody ID: COC-4721. Doc links: https://vendor.notarifypro/flow/COC-4721
Devon Lee: That's over the $75 threshold. @Marcus can you approve the extra spend? If yes, Finance will code to cost center ENG-HIRING-2026.
Marcus Holt: Approve up to $150 for urgent conversions. Use ENG-HIRING-2026. Facilities will sign for receipt and notify HR.
Ayesha Khan: Payroll note: if W-4 + direct deposit not in by EOD Monday, first cycle may be delayed. Also confirm tax residency for benefit eligibility (FT benefits start first of next month).
Evelyn Park: Samir confirmed US tax resident. He also requested help with benefits enrollment timing. Well schedule benefits walkthrough Day 2.
Devon Lee: Background team  once I upload paystub + offer letter that should clear the ByteWave mismatch. If still flagged, we'll ask Samir for a short notarized attestation.
Samir Patel: Thanks team  my lawyer can hand docs to NotarifyPro this morning. Ill sign the name-variation attestation now and upload it.
Legal Bot: Reminder: courier must provide an electronic audit trail and signed COC-4721 at delivery. HR should scan and attach notarized I-9 and COC to employee record, then shred originals per retention policy.
IT Support: Quick ops note: if Samir needs a loaner for Day 1, IT can provision and hold at Dev Bay C. Handoff code: RED-LOAN-909. Please confirm pickup window.
Evelyn Park: Please reserve loaner 12:00-14:00 Mon. Ill confirm once courier ETA is set.
Compliance: Marking CASE-ONB-2026-912 as pending manager approval for spend. Once courier/NotarifyPro confirm ETA, Compliance will approve chain-of-custody flow.
Marcus Holt: Facilities will expect courier today 10:30-12:00. Escort for transfer to HR: Dana.
Ayesha Khan: Payroll will standby to accept scanned W-4 + direct deposit. If bank is foreign, alert payroll now.
Samir Patel: Uploaded signed attestation + paystub. Lawyer sent confirmation to NotarifyPro. Thanks all.
Devon Lee: Great. Recap: Notary+courier approved, facilities accepting, background docs uploaded, benefits Day 2, payroll warned. Timeline looks good. :tada:
Evelyn Park: Appreciate the fast turn around. Ill post final courier confirmation and add the onboarding checklist link: https://onboard.redwood/internal/checklists/conversion-FT.
Onboard Bot: CASE-ONB-2026-912 updated: courier ETA 11:15, delivery window 11:00-12:00, status: en route.
Marcus Holt: Courier arrived, logged receipt, transferring to HR secure locker.
Legal Bot: COC-4721 received and validated. Notarized I-9 scanned and attached to employee record. Originals scheduled for shredding per retention policy.
Ayesha Khan: Payroll confirmed W-4 received and bank verified. Onboarding block cleared for payroll.
Evelyn Park: Welcome Samir  all clear for Day 1. Thanks everyone!
